window_definition: 2023-2025, the latest three fully completed calendar years in the dataset context.
scope_definition: Current required status from dancer_role_info.dominate_required: All Star or Champion.
limitations: Calendar-year window approximates the exact 36-month cutoff.
Registry points do not capture teaching, local-community work, judging, staffing, or social-dance contribution.
The calculation uses current required status as observable proxy for who may be affected; final rule language could define scope differently.
